subject.title: Add DI composition root and navigation/activation seam for tray view models

question: Should the tray adopt this DI/navigation presentation boundary now, before any existing page is converted to a view model?
rationale: The patch is additive and proven, but it establishes authoritative owners and a long-lived architectural direction that cannot be decided mechanically from tests or runtime logs alone.

options.title: Adopt the foundation now
options.body: Merge the proven additive seam so future page migrations have one documented composition, navigation-lifetime, and dispatcher boundary.

options.title: Defer until first page migration
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it by maintainer choice and require the first concrete page conversion to introduce the boundary with direct user-facing value.

recommendation.title: Adopt the foundation now
recommendation.body: Merge the proven additive seam so future page migrations have one documented composition, navigation-lifetime, and dispatcher boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Their detailed review set the relevant lifecycle and ownership acceptance criteria, making them the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
